mapping: Retain the real compile origin as one private NONE/HOST/EVAL value, independent of display/debug metadata. This projection needs only no-script versus actual-script identity, not a numeric V8 ID.

All actual parser roots start HOST, including the separately included CJS compiler's bookkeeping/function roots and its module syntax probe. The linked __JS_EvalInternal entry selects EVAL for actual direct/indirect eval, including all dynamic Function constructors. Child definitions inherit the real compilation origin.

Actual bytecode call sites copy that origin, including the no-PC metadata branch; native and caller-filename-only synthetic call sites have no compiled Script owner. Existing complete-struct clone preserves the field.

Bytecode version 30 carries origin even when debug/source data is stripped; version 29 is rejected by the unchanged version gate, and invalid origin 3 is rejected before bytecode ownership allocation.
